notes: The before harness retained every indexed file, so the standard 32 MiB sample already exceeded the largest-file-plus-16-MiB budget.
The after harness ran the full 500-file reference subtree. Each new file is hashed while indexing and again after the upload re-read so a concurrent edit cannot be uploaded under a stale decision.
Exact ArrayBuffer-backed views transfer without an input copy. The benchmark worker uses the production incremental runtime and transfer ownership protocol.
